description.en: Plugin market index for dsh-hindsight-memory, the DeepSeek Harness plugin that shares one Hindsight memory bank with omp (oh-my-pi) using identical tag semantics. Add the raw URL of this file under Plugins > Discover > Index sources.
description.zh: dsh-hindsight-memory 的插件市场索引。DSH 的「插件 → 发现 → 索引源」里填入本文件的 raw URL 即可看到本插件。本插件让 DSH 与 omp 共用同一个 Hindsight 记忆库，并用同一套标签语义做全局层/项目层分层。

description.en: Bridges the Hindsight memory service into DeepSeek Harness with omp-identical semantics: one shared bank, project tags stamped automatically, five semantic tools (recall/retain/reflect/status/hygiene) instead of raw MCP calls, plus a memory-hygiene layer that keeps the shared bank deduplicated for both agents. The plugin never exposes tags or bankId to the model.
description.zh: 把 Hindsight 记忆服务接进 DeepSeek Harness，行为与 omp 一致：同一个记忆库、项目标签自动盖章、模型只看见 recall/retain/reflect/status/hygiene 五个语义化工具，看不到裸 MCP 工具，也碰不到 tags 与 bankId。另含记忆卫生层，让共享记忆库在两端同时保持去重整洁。
